design:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one cohesive icon design contact sheet for Nexlet desktop launcher. This is a visual concept board, not a screenshot or executable app.
Primary request: Redesign ALL system settings icons so they feel intentionally designed, distinct and instantly recognizable in a dense launcher at 32–38 px. Create a polished original family of colorful softly dimensional pictograms, subtle layered forms and restrained highlights. Rounded geometric forms, bold clear silhouettes, consistent frontal/slight three-quarter perspective, consistent optical size. Avoid stock thin white line glyphs on repeated flat colored square tiles. Make the object itself carry its color and silhouette. No tiny decorative detail, no repeated generic sliders or gears except the single system settings gear.
Composition: one large portrait contact sheet, 8 columns and 10 rows, exactly 78 icons, final row has 6. Generous consistent gutters, pale neutral background, a concise Chinese label under each icon. No title, no logo, no device frame, no category panels. Keep every icon in its cell without cropping.
Palette: system/hardware blue, connectivity teal, accounts warm orange, apps/media violet, accessibility green, personalization rose. Gentle secondary accent colors and neutral white/silver surfaces allowed to clarify forms. Unified sophistication, clean modern desktop icon craft, no photorealism or toy-like thick clay.
Order, labels and metaphors (left to right, top to bottom):
Row1: 系统设置 (single precision gear); 电脑信息 (microchip with information detail); 显示器 (desktop monitor); 存储 (hard disk); 专注 (crescent and focus halo); 多任务 (overlapping differentiated windows); 投影 (screen with casting rays); 共享体验 (linked laptop and phone).
Row2: 平板模式 (tablet with stylus); 任务栏 (screen with prominent bottom dock); 通知 (bell); 远程桌面 (two screens with connecting arrow); 电源 (battery and lightning); 声音 (speaker with sound waves); 工作账户 (briefcase with ID); 邮件账户 (envelope with account seal).
Row3: 家庭用户 (group of people); 登录选项 (fingerprint); 同步 (two circular arrows around profile); 个人账户 (single portrait badge); 应用 (stack of app tiles); 网站应用 (browser with globe); 默认应用 (application tile with check); 离线地图 (folded map with download arrow).
Row4: 启动项 (rocket); 视频播放 (film frame with play); 自动播放 (disc with rotating play arrow); 蓝牙 (bluetooth rune); 鼠标 (computer mouse); 触摸板 (trackpad and gesture); 手写笔 (fountain pen nib); 打印机 (printer with paper).
Row5: 输入 (text cursor and small input field); USB (USB connector); 辅助功能 (accessible person figure); 辅助音频 (ear and wave); 字幕 (caption bubble with CC); 颜色滤镜 (overlapping color lenses); 辅助显示 (large and small letter A); 高对比度 (half light half dark disk).
Row6: 键盘 (keyboard); 放大镜 (magnifying lens); 键控鼠标 (cursor and arrow keys); 讲述人 (open book with spoken waves); 语音交互 (speaking profile and response bubble); 字体 (serif T); 网络流量 (bars with up/down arrows); 网络拨号 (modem with telephone).
Row7: 以太网 (ethernet jack); 网络代理 (three connected relay nodes); 网络 (globe); Wi-Fi (radiating arcs); VPN (secure network tunnel and lock); 桌面背景 (landscape picture); 系统颜色 (fan of color swatches); 锁屏 (screen with padlock).
Row8: 开始菜单 (four-pane start grid); 主题 (layered appearance cards); 隐私 (shield with eye); 日期时间 (clock with calendar); 区域语言 (globe with A and 文); 语音 (microphone); 系统激活 (key with approval seal); 备份 (storage box and backup arrow).
Row9: 查找设备 (laptop with location pin); 开发者 (code brackets and terminal); 系统恢复 (rewind arrow around system disk); 疑难解答 (wrench and diagnostic pulse); 系统安全 (protective shield with check); 系统更新 (download arrow and circular cycle); 外观 (light and dark split palette); 桌面程序坞 (desktop monitor with floating dock).
Row10: 共享 (connected outward arrows); 时间机器 (clock with reverse orbit); 屏幕时间 (hourglass in screen); 聚焦搜索 (spotlight cone and magnifier); 互联网账户 (cloud and profile); 隔空投送 (concentric wireless rings and center point).
Text: use precisely the concise Chinese labels above. Typography quiet, dark gray, consistently sized. The main focus is the icons.
Constraints: all 78 listed concepts exactly once. Consistent quality across the entire board. Distinguish each icon by silhouette and meaningful shape, not merely by hue. This is a single design board for reviewing the full family.
extraction:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the provided approved Nexlet system-settings icon contact sheet.
Produce a production TRANSPARENT SPRITE ATLAS from this exact sheet.
Change ONLY: remove the pale background, all Chinese labels beneath the icons, and all cast shadows/glows outside the icon silhouettes. Keep actual white/light-grey surfaces INSIDE the icons opaque. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere else.
Preserve ALL 78 original icons exactly: their designs, silhouettes, colors, details, relative positions, scale and ordering. Do not redesign or simplify any icon, do not add icons, do not duplicate or omit anything. Preserve the 8-column first nine rows and the centered six icons in the last row. Preserve the exact canvas aspect ratio, existing gutters and positions so each icon can be extracted individually afterwards. Empty transparent regions where text was removed.
Edges must be clean with antialiased alpha. Do not draw a checkerboard or white rectangle. No text of any kind. Output the complete high-resolution atlas.
cleanup:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit this transparent icon atlas. One targeted correction ONLY: remove all stray colored speckles, noisy cyan/blue/white fringes, remaining background flecks, diffuse shadows, halos and glows surrounding the solid icon shapes.
Keep all 78 icons, their exact positions, exact scale, approved designs, all solid white and grey highlights INSIDE objects, and original colors. Do NOT rearrange, redesign, add text, or remove objects. Keep 1122:1402 portrait aspect. All inter-icon empty space must be truly zero-alpha clean. Each object edge should be smooth antialiased alpha with no colored fringe. Preserve solid fine details such as sound waves and device antennae. Output a clean transparent PNG atlas suitable for use on a dark desktop background.
